pronunciation: loo (low tone, like saying 'lu' with a dip in pitch)

example.romanization: Liá thiàu lu hó hàng mò?
example.english: Is this road easy to walk/travel on?

note: 路 shows up in many compound travel words like 路口 (lu-héu, intersection) and 迷路 (mì-lu, to get lost), so learning it early unlocks a lot of direction-related vocabulary.
